src: But before we continue, I need to prepare some things.
Let's talk again next time you visit New Delphi.
What happened?
Tell me everything!
He was mutilated and there was blood all over the place.
He is dead now, but before he died he mentioned something about the Godhunters.
The Godhunters?
This is bad.
You there!
Yes?
Go to Titans Heart and check the situation there!
Ah, fuck.
There goes my cozy guard job.
Did you say something?
No, no, no.
I'm going, I'm going.
Thank you very much for telling us about that.
This is dire news indeed.
Did that Historian talk again?
I told him to guard his mouth.
Please leave this matter be.
There is good reason why we tell the story this way.
Alright. You don't have to tell me.
Ah, it's good to see you're reasonable.
Have a pleasant day.
I insist. Tell me!
I see that it is not worth arguing this with you.
But you will have to prove your devotion to the Titans beforehand.
No way.
It's probably not worth it anyway.
I knew this would be your answer.
Talk to me again when you wish to prove your devotion.
Alright.
What do I need to do?
Complete the final steps of a pilgrims trial, prove your devotion, and we may talk about this again.
Complete your pilgrimage, and we may talk about this again.
But I am preoccupied with the situation around the Titans Heart.
Please ask again once this is over.
But you will have to finish proving your devotion to the Titans beforehand.
Which, of course, can only happen once I finished my preparations for the final step.
So please stay patient until then.
You will have to prove your devotion before I will say anything.
Once we are done with the last step of you becoming a true believer, ask me again.
You will have to prove your devotion before I will say anything.
I apologize, but we are still in worry with what happened to the Heart of the Titan.
I cannot entertain this matter right now.
So it's finally come to this.
I wish I didn't have to, but you have proven yourself more than worthy.
No matter how much I wished this to remain a secret.
I was burdened with the key to the gate down below.
Behind which lie the remnants of this place's past.
But the Titans have heard my prayers and lifted this weight from me.
The key is gone.
And with it my ability to present you the secret.
And with it my ability to present you the answer.
Here, take this and walk through the gate down there.
Experience yourself what this place used to be.
Oh, how I wish you wouldn't ask.
So it's finally come to this.
I hoped that by sending you away I wouldn't have to tell you.
Hello?
You're still interested in talking with me?
How exciting.
What do you need?
Why won't the others talk to you?
Oh, I don't know.
The others, they're more interested in the rites and stuff.
Not the stories our community is actually built upon.
I guess I'm boring them.
Except for the High Priest, maybe.
Even though we don't agree on many things, he was always kind to me.
Anything else?
What was that about the true story of this place?
No, no, no.
The High Priest told me not to talk about this.
This is just an ancient place that is older than the Bleeding.
And the Sleeper chose one of the pools here as his resting place.
There's nothing more to it.
So stop asking me about this.
Who is the Sleeper?
One of the Flesh Titans.
It is said that he used to wander around the deserts in this area.
But one day he decided to take his rest in the pools.
So New Delphi became a holy place.
And the pilgrims come here to pray to him.
At least that's the official story.
The documents tell something else.
Oh, wait. The High Priest told me not to talk about that.
What is this Bleeding?
It happened a long time ago.
This planet used to be completely normal.
But then it started to rain blood and flesh.
For a long time. Maybe years even.
There aren't many records from that time.
And soon after, the Titans started appearing.
What are the Flesh Titans?
Mysterious beings of flesh.
They started appearing after the Bleeding.
Where they go, the flesh grows.
And with the flesh comes life.
At least that's what we believe.
But their history is very murky.
So, what is the history of this place?
These are the ruins of New Delphi.
This place was old even before the Bleeding.
The pools are filled with mysterious liquids.
And the Sleeper chose one of them as his resting place.
Who are you?
I'm the Historian.
I study the history of places connected to the Flesh Titans.
But documentation is scarce.
HELLO!
Oh, you're talking to me.
No one ever talks to me.
As we consume the flesh, the flesh will consume us.
My prayers will be heard.
I'm here to pray.
It's too fucking hot.
I'm so thirsty.
These ruins were already ancient when the bleeding happened.
I travelled for five days, just to see the sleeper.
They say New Delphi is hiding a secret.
Have you not met the sleeper?
I did not expect it to be so hot here.
The High Priest is wise.
I travelled from far away, and still no hookup.
For the flesh.
Be blessed by the flesh.
Follow the Titans.
As you will.
May the wounds close in peace.
The sun will rise again.
Mind your body.
Do not hesitate. Do!
Remember to be.
May the Titans offer you peace.
Go, my child.
Know your will.
Praise the flesh.
Protect yourself.
Believe in the blood.
You have come back.
Will you let the Titans bless you?
Do the blessings even work?
That Titan over there doesn't seem very active.
Be quiet, fool!
Do not let the pilgrims waver in their belief.
Take the Historian as your example, quietly staying down in his hut.
This place is blessed by the sleeper, and nobody's words may defile it.
Such is the glory of the Titans.
What's with the big guy in the pool?
Do not speak ill of the sleeper.
He is a Titan who wandered these lands and decided to take his rest, right here.
He has blessed us with his presence.
And we share his blessings with the rest of all the people.
Even one as you may receive them.
Who are all these people?
The souls, once lost, who have found their way to truth.
They come from far and wide to show their devotion as pilgrims.
They are here to receive the blessing of the Titans.
The strongest among them have even decided to stay, and put their entire being in front of the masters.
You too could be one of them.
But you have far surpassed them in both strength and devotion already.
The Titans?
Oh you poor soul, don't you know of them?
Our guardians and masters.
They saw our sinful ways, and came to lead us to bliss.
Where they go, the flesh grows.
And where the flesh grows, life blooms.
Praise them, my child, for they still have hope for you.
Come, and join us in praise.
Surely you jest.
You have saved one's seedling after all.
They are the ones who have sent you to help us.
Oh, what an oddity do my eyes see.
A child, that has not yet joined the flock.
Come here, come here.
Let the grace of the Titans bless you, like it blesses all the others.
You are back.
Titans bless you.
I have heard of your heroic tale.
The Titans must have big plans for you.
Hello.
Hi.
Welcome.
Hey, sister.
I have a question regarding the celibacy.
What do you mean? We have no rules enforcing celibacy.
WHAT? All this time I live in abstinence, and... no one ever told me?
*shrugs*
Alright. Gonna make the best of that now.
Hey, brother.
What's up?
Look who's here.
Finally decided to come over, right? You were staring at me the whole time.
I was not.
You were.
I was not.
Alright. See you later.
For the Flesh!
Hail the Flesh!
I need to eat something.
Yeah, well. Whatever.
Do you have some food that is not meat? Can I have it?
Hahaha.
Hail the Flesh!
All Hail the Meat.
Did you read that passage about uniting the children?
Do you know if that's us? The children, I mean.
Do I look like I'm in charge? I have no idea really.
It could literally mean children, right? Perhaps it's a hint that we should begin making some?
I'm not so sure about that.
Hey. How is it today?
Painful. But I don't want to complain too much.
And yours?
More than painful. Fucking hell, really.
It's like someone decided to make this a hellhole for me, raining shit from...
Ah, well, don't want to complain either.
Welcome!
So, how did they capture you?
I was out to take a piss.
And they were hiding in the bush.
Let's say they weren't very happy with the situation.
Praise the Titans!
Praise be.
I miss my wife.
You have a wife?
No.
But if I had one, I'd be missing her after all this time.
How long have we been here for?
I don't know.
Wasn't it your turn to count the days?
Shit. I forgot.
Hey!
Hey, sister. Sister.
I have a question regarding the celibacy. Celibacy.
What do you mean? What? We have no rules enforcing celibacy. No rules.
WHAT? WHAT? All this time I live in abstinence, and... no one ever told me? No one?
*shrugs*

I was not. Was not.
You were. You.
I was not. Was not.
Alright. Alright. See you later. See you.

Hail the Hierarch! The Hierarch!
I need to eat something. Need to eat.
